local_changes: Matched six control bodies to Christian's physical wheel: left large/inner thumb rotaries red; right large/inner thumb rotaries and both joysticks blue. Exact diffuse RGB values and CAD triangle spans are recorded in ascher-artura.colors.json. Only those control UVs and previously unused atlas tiles14/15 changed; positions, normals, indices, display and LED assignments remain unchanged. Christian confirmed the colors in VR; these are subjective matches, not calibrated material measurements.
Preserved the original position/normal data and diffuse atlas; tagged 21 shift-light diffusers and 14 illuminated button-symbol CAD bodies using the installed SimHub physical mapper.
Duplicated the 14 original rounded screen triangles 0.05 mm forward with full dashboard UVs; preserved original dark glass when the dashboard is disabled.
Added built-in catalog metadata, integrity manifest and physical device6 support. Mapping details and source body/triangle ranges are in ascher-artura.mapping.json.
Rebuild with python scripts/build-artura-wheel.py using only the bundled editable source archive and mapping; no supplied converter code is executed.
Preserved original OBJ/MTL, muted prototype, conversion report and software license as compressed editable source; excluded source-only ZIP from installer resources.
limitations: The supplied placement translation is +0.0666667 normalized Z, or 20 mm toward the driver at 300 mm wheel width. This does not add or extend hub geometry.
Diffuse material colors only; no PBR roughness/metallic, carbon or label image textures.
Source package reports unresolved button flicker on the original rig; no headset validation or correction is claimed.

validation.geometry: All 564102 vertices checked for finite bounded positions, unit normals, UV bounds; all 564102 indices in range; width normalized to1. 14 diffuse colors preserved.
validation.mapping: Installed SimHub mapper and default LED profile establish physical63-channel layout, 21 shift lights,14 button lights; no remapping of unused physical channel gaps.
validation.hardware: Synthetic GPU and loopback validation are separate from physical-wheel and headset validation; no hardware LED flashing performed.
validation.gpu: Production D3D11 renderer readback inspected for both eyes with a four-corner dashboard test page and distinct physical LED colors:0 green headlight,21 blue microphone,42 red left-bottom flag,60 yellow right-top flag. Synthetic D3D11/D3D12 renderer tests and Electron/native-host/SimHub-loopback tests passed.
